Policy work the owner decided, as recorded:

> - **Decided by tvofi (2026-10-14): fold this into D7 permanently, after the judge rules.** Once Phase 2 has judged the ARCH-s1/s2/s3 findings, dispatch a policy fixer to:
>   - edit `dev/governance/dimensions/D7.md` to add M7 (arch-score opportunities, all counters on, behaviour gate, architectural argument, with "review trigger, never a target") and M8 (a duplicated-shape census: enumerate the implementations by seam rule, an agreement test, one owner);
>   - write both steps from what the judge confirmed and voided;
>   - re-cut D7's three seats in `scopes.json` and `rotation.json` across M1–M8;
>   - update `check-wave-script` and `check_scopes` as needed.
> 
>   It merges under the mandate. If the arch seats return dry or mostly void, record that "a one-time run was enough" and leave D7 unchanged.
> - The D7 M7/M8 policy fold records the 150 % bar as the guideline.
> - Owed brief edits (finding-propagation, go with recommended = adopt): D1 step 3 checks the published/booked value, not only the plan; D2 step 5 tests learners under error in the other covariate; confirm the 35 evidence-only N-move-stale-path seams are by-design under D2 (ledger count overstated). Land with the D7 M7/M8 policy fold PR.
> - Catch-up study rows: ID-01 verify medium; ID-02 verify medium (production freeze latches 0.98, unmetered installs, shortfall >55%); D-1 verify low (30.4% low vs truth; wood forecast only); D-2 REFUTE (instrument; leftover: published heat_loss_kw_per_c on (U+L) basis reads 22% low = label hygiene) → R10-RATIO-SITES shrinks to D-1 + label; D-3 verify medium. Sysid-stage brief lead: experiment aborts "drifted beyond excursion" at scale 1.3x & r>=1.2 (fails safe).
> - CATCHUP-JUDGE (33ffa7aa9 on handoff/audit-r10-catchup-verify): 39 verified, 5 weakened, 3 refuted (D-2, L4, D9-s1-02), 3 merged. Maps onto #2219/2222/2223/2228/2232/2235/2236/2238/2239/2241/2242/2243. Proposed new classes: N-leaf-imports-solver, N-restore-race, N-order-coupling, + N-solve-recompute issue. Reconcile with JUDGE.json: D2-s3-73 off #2239; D2-s3-72 high→medium; D2-s1-71 medium→low; D7-s3-54 bug→hygiene; D7-s2-61 → weakened P1; D7-s2-56 → bug. Fixer notes: D7-arch2-11 also needs a range bound (a 100 kW reading); re-measure D7-s1-82's ΔS after the census is extended.

**Evidence.** Owner decision 2026-10-14; owed edits from the Phase-2 RCAs (d23205d13) and the catch-up judge's residuals (33ffa7aa9).

**Roster group.** `R10-BRIEFS-FOLD` in `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` (lane IN, wave 3, size M, after: R10-ARCHSCORE-COVERAGE, R10-D15-GRADER). The group's brief carries the fix shape, the null control and the forward-carried constraints.

**Closing.** The group's pull request names this issue with a closing keyword in prose; the orchestrator verifies it closed after the merge.
title: [R10-BRIEFS-FOLD] Fold arch-score into D7 (M7/M8) and land the round's owed dimension-brief edits
